FIVE FINDINGS. (1) c_5 CONTRADICTS ITS OWN PROPOSITION -- see the verdict on prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder. This block says c_5 = c_3^2*3 + b (twice: in the mixing-pattern list and in open question 2); the proposition's boxed formula and tables 1 and 2 say c_5 = -(b^2+1/2). I recomputed and THIS BLOCK IS THE CORRECT ONE: with u^5 = 4.4822186e-11, c_5 = +12.8675841 contributes +0.5768 ppb and carries table 2's N=4 residual of -0.57 ppb to +0.0068 ppb, matching the published '~0 ppb' and table 3's '+0.04 ppb'; the -(b^2+1/2) form contributes only -0.0561 ppb and would leave -0.63 ppb. The proposition needs correcting, not this remark. (2) STALE c_3 VALUE: 'c_3: -2.010 at the muon-pin q_0, -2.069 at the m_p-pin q_0'. Per AGENTS.md the muon-pin c_3 is -2.02020024; -2.0097 is the SUPERSEDED pre-#1422 value that -2.010 rounds to. The stale pair implies a cross-anchor swing of 2.85 percent, whereas the current pair gives 2.37478 percent. AGENTS.md flags this exact stale figure as the source of the corpus's '2.98%/2.88%' numbers. (3) SWEEP DAMAGE, three sites: the section heading 'canonical precision ladder' (read: 'Numerical precision ladder'), 'Verified at q_0 via the canonical formalism at 50 dps', and 'From the canonical formalism:' before the epsilon_DeltaS formula. All three are the documented token substitution where a script name belonged; I could not recover the names, so none was fixed. (4) PIN CURRENCY vs THE LIVE DASHBOARD: the block claims the N=3 rung beats the 7.80 ppb target and that N>=4 reaches sub-ppb on Q_beta. AGENTS.md records the live per-observable dashboard at 1279 ppb for Q_beta (a 164x miss), explicitly noting that the sub-ppb Habiro result was against the PRE-re-pin muon q_0 and has not been refreshed since the 2026-05-28 proton re-pin. The block's precision claims should be scoped to the muon-era run. (5) CONVENTION C, as for the proposition: the ladder is C-frame throughout via z in alpha, already scoped corpus-wide by bean qou-cds1.
